image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a crumpled baby diaper lying on a textured beige fabric surface. The diaper features a pastel tie-dye or watercolor pattern with shades of yellow, blue, and pink. It has elasticized leg openings with gathered ruffles and visible adhesive fastening tabs on the side panels. A white tag is attached to the waistband area.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture on the right side panel appears slightly smeared or overly smooth compared to the rest of the fabric, lacking the fine micro-texture seen elsewhere. There is a slight 'melting' look where the tab meets the background.

The white tag attached to the waistband lacks clear text or branding and seems to merge slightly with the fabric behind it, suggesting a minor generation artifact in rendering small, detailed objects.
